acceptanceCriteria: The current slot combination rule is documented with a file and function citation before the comparison runs.
Both variants run on the same frozen benchmark with comparability blocks recorded in docs/BUILD-LOG.md.
No behaviour change ships from this spike; a follow-up FEATURE ticket is filed only if the measurement supports it.
body: Owner requested this on 2026-09-23 after reviewing Tencent/WeKnora (MIT) as prior art; this ticket records an idea, not delivery or promotion. Original Go work only; no source import. WeKnora is an LLM-at-ingest, database-backed RAG platform, so only the mechanism is borrowed and it must stay deterministic, local and read-only under AGENTS.md invariants 4 and 7. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Prior art: website-docs/03-features/05-retrieval-engines.md of https://github.com/Tencent/WeKnora. Hybrid results are fused at the application layer with reciprocal rank fusion, `score = w_v/(k + rank_v) + w_k/(k + rank_k)`, each channel ranked independently and 1-indexed; per-engine score normalisation to [0,1] precedes fusion; a query answered by one channel bypasses fusion so native scores survive threshold comparison; duplicates keep the highest score per chunk; over-retrieval takes max(topK*5, 50) candidates before rerank. Current state: slots are lexical BM25, cochange, pair/test, reverse-import, reference, sibling and documentation with heterogeneous score scales, and a search of internal found no rank-based fusion; how slot scores combine today must be read from internal/contextindex before any change. Idea: measure RRF (with the single-channel bypass and max-score dedup) against the current combination on the frozen retrieval evaluation and the dev/held-out split; adopt only if recall at fixed byte budgets does not regress and the result stays deterministic. Owning spec: docs/specs/task-context-packet-v0.md; evaluation contract: docs/specs/retrieval-eval-comparability-v0.md.
title: context: measure rank-based fusion across retrieval slots against the current merge
